# ShoreDay

> Independent Nassau port-day planning for cruise passengers, in one WhatsApp chat. $15 USD once for a whole group, one WhatsApp number and one Nassau port call.

ShoreDay is operated by VMAManagement LLC. It is not affiliated with any cruise line or Nassau Cruise Port. Nassau only.

## Offer

Send your ship, Nassau date, all-aboard time, group, budget and day preferences. An automated assistant builds a plan backward from all-aboard. The ship's official all-aboard time and onboard instructions always take priority. Times and recommendations are estimates.

The offer includes a personal plan, a 17-page offline PDF kit, and WhatsApp help through the end of the Nassau port day, as stated in the Concierge Terms. Human help is available daily 1–5 PM ET; type HUMAN. Automated answers are available during the access period. Food, rides and optional tours cost extra. ShoreDay may earn a commission on tour bookings. App premium is included for the purchaser, on iOS and Android. The app is separate from the WhatsApp conversation.

Free to message before paying. Full refund before the personalized plan is sent. After delivery, non-refundable unless ShoreDay fails to provide the described service. The Concierge Terms control.

## Capabilities and limits

Ask for a leave-by time, back-at-pier target and exact time remaining. Send photos of menus, price boards, signs or recognizable landmarks, short videos or PDFs. Ask for an ATM, pharmacy or beach with a Google Maps link. Voice replies are available when the guest speaks first or asks. Spanish messages receive Spanish answers.

The concierge does not send automatic reminders or set alarms. Ask for two alarm times to set yourself. The plan and downloaded PDF are readable offline. Play voice notes once while connected so downloaded notes can replay offline. New messages and replies need internet. Check Bahamas coverage with your phone provider.

Chat history stays on the phone unless deleted. The concierge engine does not store media, but media and messages are processed to answer questions; consult the Privacy Policy. A return visit is a new $15 Nassau port call.

Day shapes include beach and water, a downtown walk, local food and heritage. Parents or adults can plan for children by sharing ages, stroller needs and walking preferences. Agree fares before taxi rides and confirm prices with businesses. No safety promises or claim of special access.

For passengers on Royal Caribbean, Carnival, MSC, Disney, Norwegian, Margaritaville at Sea, Celebrity, Princess, Virgin Voyages, Scenic, TUI and any ship stopping in Nassau. This is a fit list, not an endorsement or fixed sailing schedule.
